Stack desktop fonts

These notices describe the actual source font files in Assets/Fonts.
Version, copyright and license identifiers below are transcribed from each
font's embedded name table. Font names do not imply sponsorship or endorsement.
Stack's source license does not replace the licenses for these fonts.

Roboto is embedded by tools/assets/bake_fonts.py. Press Start 2P and
Silkscreen are loaded from src/App/Resources/Embedded8BitFont.h.
Keep these notices and the applicable license texts with binary packages
containing these fonts. These terms govern the fonts, not users' images.
